justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/InjectionClassLoader.java` (163 LOC) along with `ByteArrayClassLoader.java`, `MultipleParentClassLoader.java`, and `InjectionClassLoaderTest.java`. The class is small and cohesive: one state field (`sealed`), two state methods (`isSealed`, `seal`), one injection path (`defineClass`/`defineClasses`), one abstract hook (`doDefineClasses`), and one tiny nested `Strategy` adapter. The subclasses and tests show these pieces all serve the same concern of controlled class injection, so there is no strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
